The broken white lane line permits crossing into the adjacent same-direction lane with care.

answer.scene: A multi-lane urban street approaches a signalized intersection. My car is in the third of four visible general-traffic lanes from the left, behind a silver vehicle.

left_boundary.observation: A single solid white line separates my lane from the lane occupied by the box truck; no curb forms this boundary.

right_boundary.observation: A single solid white line separates my lane from the lane occupied by the black sedan; no curb forms this boundary.

lane_markings.observation: A white arrow in my lane has one head pointing straight ahead.
A solid white transverse stop line crosses my lane ahead of the arrow and before the crosswalk.
White longitudinal crosswalk bars cross the approach beyond the stop line, with part obscured by the silver vehicle.

cross_check.position: The third lane of four has another same-direction lane on each side, consistent with both boundaries being lane lines.
cross_check.roles: Both boundaries are white, consistent with separating same-direction traffic; their visible approach stretches are solid.
cross_check.markings: The straight arrow agrees with the through-lane alignment; the stop line precedes the crosswalk.
cross_check.unseen: No markings underneath vehicles are inferred; the crosswalk's occlusion is recorded.

element_rules.meaning: The solid white lane line discourages crossing to the left but does not prohibit it.
The solid white lane line discourages crossing to the right but does not prohibit it.
The straight-only lane-use arrow permits proceeding straight and restricts this lane against left turns, right turns, and U-turns.
The stop line identifies where to stop when the traffic control requires stopping, without governing the seven movement choices.
No supplied passage specifically covers crosswalk markings; this pedestrian crossing does not govern the seven movement choices.

action_reasons.change_left: US-3B.06-05-06 discourages, but does not prohibit, crossing the solid white left lane line.
action_reasons.change_right: US-3B.06-05-06 discourages, but does not prohibit, crossing the solid white right lane line.
action_reasons.go_straight: The straight arrow permits this movement under US-3B.23-01.
action_reasons.turn_left: The straight-only arrow restricts this lane against a left turn under US-3B.23-01.
action_reasons.turn_right: The straight-only arrow restricts this lane against a right turn under US-3B.23-01.
action_reasons.u_turn: The straight-only arrow restricts this lane against a U-turn under US-3B.23-01.
action_reasons.enter_waiting_area: No marked left-turn waiting area or adjacent two-way left-turn lane is visible.

answer.advice: Use this lane to continue straight; a turn requires selecting an appropriately marked lane beforehand, and crossing either solid white lane line is discouraged. Follow the traffic signal, stop behind the stop line when required, and keep the crosswalk clear.
